scope: Implement one hidden-looking authored encounter, its workshop entry, per-save resume and stance callback, and accessible responsive dialogue; preserve all practical routes. Stop for owner slice review before expansion or release.
user_job: Discover something personal and amusing about the Steward, choose how to respond, and leave or return freely without managing another task.

active_sources.judged_state: Owner-approved one-scene visual-novel encounter within the accepted workshop art, not a character FAQ.

superseded_sources.reason: Owner clarified visual-novel discovery and approved a bounded scene; the prior ephemeral FAQ does not express that intention. Daily capacity and readability scope remain unchanged.

product.decision: A crosswise file-box card reveals one character-specific soup dispute; practical planning never requires entering or completing it.
product.proof: Enter from empty and populated workshop registers, complete or leave the scene, and verify all practical callbacks and planning/reward data remain unchanged.

interaction.decision: Read one line at a time, choose actual replies, leave and resume, and receive a stance-specific later callback with no automatic advance or reward.
interaction.proof: Drive all branches through production widgets, reload serialized memory, replay and rapid tap, and verify accessible compact reachability.

visual.decision: Keep authored room and pose planes; place readable live dialogue below the face, with physical card discovery and appropriate reading/offering/filing acting.
visual.proof: Inspect fresh discovery, dialogue, choice, card, ending and callback renders at 430x932 and compact large-text top/action states against the accepted workshop composition.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: A list of biography questions or app help
anti_fallbacks.why: The owner asked to discover a character through a small event, not interview a help system.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Affinity, XP, daily episodes, completion badges or required progression
anti_fallbacks.why: This must stay optional delight rather than another thing the player has to maintain.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Tiny invisible hotspot or low-contrast text for the sake of mystery
anti_fallbacks.why: Discovery must work for touch, keyboard and assistive access without repeating the owner's legibility complaint.

first_real_slice.scenario: Notice an unfiled card, read the dispute, choose a stance, leave midway and resume, finish and revisit the file box.
first_real_slice.real_inputs: Normal GameState, existing goals and Quests, registered workshop art, ordinary persisted save JSON, and deterministic authored story nodes.
first_real_slice.user_action: Tap the physical card, advance/read/choose at one's own pace, return to the bench, reopen, finish, and revisit.
first_real_slice.expected_outcome: A specific character encounter with remembered stance and no practical-planning or reward mutation; same room remains readable and controllable.
first_real_slice.state_boundary: Only GameState.stewardMemory is modified; normal save callback persists it. Existing whole-save cloud semantics are unchanged.

required_states.state: Empty and populated workshop with optional card entry
required_states.why_can_disprove: An obligatory or missing entry would either burden planning or prevent discovering the scene.

required_states.state: All conversational branches, completion and stance callbacks
required_states.why_can_disprove: Cosmetic choices or identical callbacks would remove the proposed remembered response.

required_states.state: Leave, serialized reload, unknown saved node, replay
required_states.why_can_disprove: Lost progress, crashes or overwritten completion would make a short optional scene unreliable.

required_states.state: 320x568 at 1.5x and 2x text with Reduced Motion
required_states.why_can_disprove: Clipped copy or unreachable replies would repeat the installed-phone accessibility failure.

ripple_map.state: New, discovered, in-progress, completed, empty, crowded
ripple_map.expected_effect: Optional entry without disrupting exact route actions.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Widget integration tests and discovery renders.

ripple_map.expected_effect: Bounded optional memory without other progression changes.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Focused JSON and scene invariant tests.

ripple_map.surface_or_primitive: Existing Steward artwork and live dialogue
ripple_map.expected_effect: Existing art remains intact and line choices remain readable.

unverified_property: Whether this scene feels like a worthwhile personal discovery rather than a gimmick, and whether pacing and readability feel good on the owner's phone.

decisive_check.method: Run complete production-widget journeys and inspect fresh rendered acting and compact text, then obtain owner response and physical phone review.
decisive_check.target: One complete optional file-box scene plus discovery, resume, stance callbacks and unchanged route register.
decisive_check.pass_condition: Distinct character voice, coherent physical acting, meaningful choice memory, no planning mutation, readable reachable controls, and explicit owner acceptance.
